title: Gateway is the authority on read/write sets and outbox (B3-40 TODO)
outcome: Read/write sets come from the state txn, not tool self-reports; mismatches and refusals become recorded denials, never unrecorded raises
acceptance: Gateway takes read_set/write_set from the StateTxn; an Execution whose sets disagree with the txn is a recorded deny (test with a lying adapter)
Write without txn and non-empty outbox before B3-23 become recorded denials, not raises after the tool ran (rule 11: every envelope recorded)
Outbox items are created by the gateway from Execution.outbox with derived idempotency_key and lineage (with B3-23)
